'''Jon Gaelin''' is a [[Two Rivers]] resident.

== Activities ==
When [[Perrin Aybara]] convinces [[Jac al'Seen]] and his family to move to [[Emond's Field]], Jac says that he will stop and tell Jon Gaelin.{{ref/book|4|33}}

In preparation for the Perrin's trial by [[Morgase Trakand]], Jon, [[Flann Barstere]], and [[Marek Cormer]] ready their bows.{{ref/book|13|34}}
